title: Genotype with Quant Studio 12K Flex Protocol
author: Na Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pvbdn2n
materials: 30 independent SNPs derived from genome-wide association studies (S1 Table), were customized by Thermo Fisher Scientific company, USA. Custom TaqMan® Assay Design Tool was used for Custom Assays design, the following is the website: https://www.thermofisher.com/order/custom-genomic-products/ tools/genotyping/ . Plate setup files (*.tpf or *.spf) contain the assay information for individual TaqMan®OpenArray® plates, including the gene symbol, gene name, assay ID, and location ofeach assay on the plate.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA from blood
steps.instruction: Extract high‑molecular‑weight genomic DNA from 2 mL venous blood using the QuickGene 610L Automatic DNA/RNA Extraction System (Fujifilm, Tokyo, Japan).

steps.title: Quantify DNA purity
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop 8000 and verify that the A260/A280 ratio is between 1.7 and 2.0.

steps.title: Normalize DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute each sample with double‑distilled water to a final volume of 10 µL at 30 ng/µL, placing the normalized DNA into a 96‑well plate so that each through‑hole receives the same input quantity.

steps.title: Create sample tracker file
steps.instruction: Use the OpenArray® Sample Tracker Software to generate a *.csv file that records the location of each sample in the 96‑well plate, then export the table‑format CSV.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix and 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR reaction in the 384‑well plate as follows:

substeps.instruction: Thaw the 96‑well reaction plate containing the normalized gDNA at room temperature, vortex, then spin 1 min at 1000 rpm.
Mix the 2× TaqMan® OpenArray® Genotyping Master Mix by gently inverting the bottle 10 times.
Add 2 µL of the master mix to each well of the 384‑well sample plate.
Using a 12‑channel pipette, transfer 2 µL of normalized gDNA from the 96‑well plate to the corresponding wells of the 384‑well plate.
Cover the 384‑well plate with foil and centrifuge 1 min at 1000 rpm to eliminate bubbles.

steps.title: Transfer samples to OpenArray plate
steps.instruction: Load the 384‑well plate onto the QuantStudio™ OpenArray™ AccuFill™ System and transfer samples to the OpenArray plate:

substeps.instruction: Confirm that the OpenArray 384‑well sample plate, AccuFill™ System loader tips, and plate holder are correctly positioned.
Remove an OpenArray® plate from the freezer and let it equilibrate at room temperature for 10 min.
Prepare a syringe filled with OpenArray® Immersion Fluid and attach the tip.

Close the instrument enclosure, start the QuantStudio™ OpenArray™ AccuFill™ software, and when prompted, open the door, remove the indicated OpenArray plate, immediately seal it with the OpenArray case lid, and load the case with immersion fluid.

steps.title: Load plate into QuantStudio and run
steps.instruction: Run the OpenArray plate on the QuantStudio™ 12K Flex instrument:

substeps.instruction: Place the OpenArray plate on the plate adapter, ensuring proper alignment and that the barcode faces up and toward the front of the instrument.
Click “Get Plate IDs” to import the barcode information.
Start the instrument run with the following thermal profile: 10 min at 93 °C; then 50 cycles of 45 s at 95 °C, 13 s at 94 °C, and 2 min at 53.5 °C; finally 2 min at 25 °C.

steps.title: Process run output file
steps.instruction: After the run, close the experiment, reopen the generated *.eds file, display the Allelic Discrimination Plot, and integrate the sample names and assay IDs into the *.eds file.

steps.title: Export and analyze results
steps.instruction: Export the experiment results to another computer and analyze them with TaqMan Genotype Analyzer v1.3.1.

steps.title: Export final data as CSV
steps.instruction: From the analyzed results, export the data in QuantStudio™ 12K Flex format (*.csv) for further analysis.

description: Review the flags in the QC Summary, such as NOSIGNAL, NOAMP, OFFSCALE and et al. The flags BADROX and AMPSCORE are, by default, were not in use for the Genotyping experiment, need us manually remove these samples. View and, if necessary, change the analysis settings and Click Edit Default Settings, then specify the default call settings.
